name: Honda Civic 11th gen 2.0 L NA (64S ECU)
validation: Each channel was compared with KTuner 1.0.14.1 display values on one car (2026-10-06): parked, engine-off/restart and a 26-minute drive, fixed encodings, 99.84-100% agreement on steady samples within one display step. This means "decodes what KTuner shows", not independent sensor calibration.

channels.name: lambda_measured
channels.note: Raw 65535 (lambda 2.0, AFR display 29.4) is the KTuner display ceiling: fuel cut or engine off. Not a valid lean reading. AFR = lambda x 14.7.

channels.name: lambda_commanded
channels.note: Raw 65535 = 29.4 AFR display during fuel cut; 32768 (lambda 1.0) with the engine off.

channels.name: maf_hz
channels.note: KTuner MAF.Hz is quantized to 50 Hz; this byte is that value / 50.

channels.name: map_kpa
channels.note: Scale fitted on the drive (KTuner MAP mbar / 10); exact unit basis unknown.

channels.name: ign_deg
channels.note: An earlier A37 u8 candidate, which did not track KTuner AIGN (correlation 0.04); A37 is the MAF high byte.

channels.name: ect_c
channels.note: Validated range only 77-87 C (warm engine); cold range unverified.

channels.name: speed_kph
channels.note: Little-endian km/h x 256 at bytes 20-21. Replaces A21 u16be x0.001, which read about 8% low.

channels.name: knock_ctrl
channels.note: KTuner KNK.CTRL; meaning beyond the display value is not established.

channels.name: fuel_status
channels.note: Same codes as KTuner FUEL.STAT: 1 open loop, 2 closed loop, 4 fuel cut, 0 engine off (observed).
